category_edits.rationale: Blend each recurrent state with its causal recency-weighted pooled history: 90% current state and 10% pooling with a five-step half-life. Training and prediction share this readout through the predictor's existing GRU4RecModel import.

change_summary: Apply the specified 90/10 recurrent-state and recency-pooling blend across all four category models, preserving the GRU backbone and training configuration.
